content:
The type of project delivery you are referring to is **A. integrated**.

Integrated project delivery (IPD) is a collaborative process that involves all stakeholders (owners, architects, engineers, contractors, etc.) from the early stages of the project through to completion. This method is focused on aligning the interests, objectives, and practices of all team members to optimize project results, increase value to the owner, reduce waste, and maximize efficiency through all phases of design, fabrication, and construction. 

IPD is particularly concerned with all aspects of building performance and requires close coordination of various building systems to prevent rework and conflicts, ensuring a streamlined and efficient construction process.
